column1: # v11 -- label families whose Chinese head disagreed with itself.
# Found by grouping every "X", "X: {0}", "X >= {0}" entry by its English head and
# comparing the Chinese part before the separator. Four families really did
# disagree; the rest of the 41 hits were word-order noise (Chinese moves the
# context clause to the front, so the literal head never matches).
#   Step {0}/{1}          步骤 3 / 5      vs  Step 3 of 5 complete  第 3 / 5 步完成
#   Save (verb)           保存            vs  Saves (noun)          存档
